title: Authentication popup no longer opens browser after SDK 9 update
observation: Authentication popup no longer opens browser after SDK 9 update ## Description Since the 2026.1.0 release (commit 404660d, SDK 9 + Electron 39 update), clicking the authenticate button in a Jitsi Meet conference no longer opens the browser for authentication. The authentication flow for moderator login is completely broken — pressing the button has no effect. ## Root Cause In the SDK 9 migration, `initPopupsConfigurationMain(mainWindow)` was introduced at `main.js:324`. title: Migration request
observation: Migration request This feature proposes an incremental migration of the jitsi-meet-electron codebase to TypeScript, along with modernizing existing class-based React components into functional components using hooks, where appropriate. The migration would be phased and non-breaking, allowing JavaScript and TypeScript to coexist during the transition. Initial focus would be on: UI components with minimal side effects Shared utilities and helper modules Adding type definitions for Electron IPC and global APIs The goal is to improve type safety, maintainability, and contributor experience while preserving existing functionality and behavior. This approach avoids large disruptive refactors and instead introduces TypeScript gradually through small, reviewable pull requests, aligned with modern React and Electron best practices.
